JOB OVERVIEW We are seeking a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of production processes for our autonomous surface vessel systems. You’ll be responsible for developing efficient, scalable assembly and integration procedures while collaborating closely with engineering, operations, and quality teams to ensure safety, repeatability, and reliability across builds. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who can balance day-to-day support of active builds with long-term process development. You’ll operate at the critical intersection of product design and operational execution, ensuring our manufacturing systems are robust, traceable, and ready for scale. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, WFI
jobs.description_text: With over 30,000 customers, including a third of Fortune 500 companies, Tempo is trusted by organizations across the globe to make their workflows work better. We create a suite of integrated solutions for time management, resource planning, budget management, roadmapping, program management, reporting and more. We create the tech that enables the modern team to deliver – for every step from first vision to value. Since our beginning in 2007 as a project to make a time-tracking tool to help a client – Tempo has expanded to become the #1 time management add-on for Jira, and we have developed and acquired a multitude of tools to become one of the most trusted names in the Atlassian ecosystem. We want everyone to work better – but we also want to be a tech company with a heart. Join us as we continuously innovate our award-winning products, create new solutions, and help the world work smarter, not harder. ABOUT TEMPO WORKFORCE INTELLIGENCE Tempo Workforce Intelligence is our newest product and one of our most ambitious bets: the opportunity to define how enterprises measure and manage the value of AI-powered work. Engineering organizations are investing in AI faster than they can account for it. Provider invoices show what was spent, but not what it delivered, leaving leaders to make high-stakes investment and governance decisions from incomplete evidence. Workforce Intelligence changes that by connecting AI telemetry to the Jira work items, epics, and initiatives where funded

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (Edge Dialog Systems)
jobs.description_text: Senior AI Engineer – Edge Dialog Systems BrightAI is a high-growth Physical AI company transforming how businesses interact with the physical world through intelligent automation. Our AI platform processes visual, spatial, and temporal data from billions of real-world events—captured across edge devices, mobile sensors, and cloud infrastructure—to enable intelligent decision-making at scale. We are now hiring a Sr. AI Engineer – Edge Dialog Systems to own and evolve the on-device conversational AI that powers our industrial safety wearable. The assistant guides field technicians through safety-critical procedures by voice, and it runs on the device itself, under hard latency, memory, and thermal budgets, with deterministic safeguards that take precedence over model output. This is a systems role rather than a prompt-and-retrieve role. The competencies of a strong LLM and RAG engineer are needed for the position, but the work itself is dialog systems engineering at the edge, where most conversational turns are resolved by deterministic and embedding-based methods, and the language model is the last resort rather than the first move. You will work at the intersection of natural language understanding (NLU), small language models (SLM), and embedded software, building a system in which a wrong answer is a safety concern and not merely a quality issue.
